prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: lime green. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: lime green.
Subjects: a rising paper bar; paper coins.
Opens on the down arrow, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip flips away as the down arrow inverts into a rising paper bar; paper coins stack along its top edge and hold.
Ends holding on the rising bar.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "+293% TO $2.0M".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "+293% TO $2.0M". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: No voice, no speech, no dialogue, no lyrics. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects only; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage in a 2D motion design style, photographed flat under soft, natural room light. The scene opens with <Picture 1>, featuring a purple paper ground, a cream-colored paper chip with the text "SHARE PRICE FALL" in a bold black sans-serif font, and a black halftone photographic cutout of a downward-pointing arrow with rough white torn-paper edges. The camera is a Static Shot. Immediately, the purple ground is covered by a sliding transition of a single, unbroken block of lime green matte paper that fills the entire frame. Simultaneously, the "SHARE PRICE FALL" chip slides off-screen to the left, and the downward arrow cutout flips rapidly on its horizontal axis. As it flips, the arrow inverts and transforms into a vertical black halftone paper bar that begins to rise from the bottom of the frame. At the same moment, a new cream-colored paper chip slides in and lands firmly in the upper third of the frame, featuring the clean, legible black text "+293% TO $2.0M" in an extra-bold sans-serif font. As the black bar rises, several small, circular black-and-white halftone paper cutouts representing coins rapidly pop into existence, stacking neatly along the top edge of the rising bar. Every element—the lime green ground, the cream chip, the black bar, and the coins—possesses a realistic matte paper texture with visible print dots and casts a small, soft shadow toward the bottom right, consistent with a single light source from the upper left. The motion is fast with a slight overshoot before stabilizing. The final two seconds hold the composition: the rising bar, the stacked coins, and the "+293% TO $2.0M" headline, with a very subtle, rhythmic pulsing loop of the bar's height to maintain visual energy.

overall_soundscape: A series of crisp, tactile foley sounds including the quick, dry slap of heavy paper hitting a surface, the sticky, short rip of adhesive tape, and the light, rhythmic clicking sounds of paper coins stacking.
